about_the_game:
Illuminate classics with a brush, create miracles with AI!

Welcome to "AI Painter," a creative world that cleverly combines the joy of painting with card strategy! Here, you'll transform into an imaginative painter, recreating the masterpieces of art masters through simple doodles with the magic of AI, and collecting artistic cards with unique styles.

Core Gameplay:

Magical Brush, AI Wonders: The core of "AI Painter" lies in our powerful AI image generation technology. You'll sketch your vision through simple brush strokes. When you complete your draft, just tap once, and our advanced AI will transform it into a beautiful artwork based on your creativity and inspired by classic artistic styles.

Master Styles at Your Fingertips: You'll have the opportunity to access various cards imbued with the souls of classic art. Imagine obtaining a card featuring Van Gogh's "Sunflowers" - your every stroke seems infused with this great painter's passion and colors, ultimately generating a sunflower painting filled with Van Gogh's essence. Or a card of Monet's "Water Lilies," guiding your strokes to depict a serene pond landscape full of changing light and shadows.

Card Collection, Unlimited Possibilities: By completing levels and challenges, you'll obtain various art cards. Each card represents a unique artistic style or theme, such as Van Gogh's passionate expression, Monet's interplay of light and shadow, and other classic masters' frozen moments of landscape photography. The back of each card contains key "prompt words" that drive AI image generation, with different cards guiding you to create distinctly different artworks.

Level Challenges, Step by Step Improvement: The game adopts a simple and fun level mode. Each level provides you with specific cards. Your task is to paint according to the artistic style or theme on the cards, and the AI will score based on how well your work matches the target style. High scores will unlock new levels and richer rewards.

Random Drops, Constant Surprises: During gameplay, you'll have opportunities to randomly obtain new art cards, bringing unexpected surprises and inspiration to your creations. Continuously expand your card collection and explore more unknown artistic realms.

Game Features:

Simple to Learn: No professional painting skills required - just simple doodles to experience the joy of AI artistic creation.
Rich Artistic Styles: Covering Van Gogh's passion, Monet's beauty, and other classic masters' landscape photography, introducing you to the charm of different artistic schools.
Unique Card Collection System: Each card is a key to creation; collect cards to unlock unlimited artistic possibilities.
Relaxing Casual Gameplay: Enjoy the fun of painting and exploration through simple level challenges and card collection.
AI-Driven Unlimited Creativity: Let AI be your artistic partner, transforming your imagination into unique artworks.

Join "AI Painter," pick up your brush, collect your art cards, and embark on an artistic journey full of creativity and surprises!
